assessment.scope: Selected ILCD 2011 (§3.6, pp. 47–55), JRC109369 (§4.6 p. 18 & §§4.7–4.8 pp. 19–20), JRC130796 (Abstract p. 1, §1 p. 3, §2 Table 1 p. 6, §3 Table 2 p. 8, §3.2 p. 9), twenty CRC32/HTTP-206 verified official EF 3.1 XML members (b5c610fe Photochemical ozone, b5c619fa Marine eutrophication, b5c602c6 Particulate matter, b5c629d6 Ozone depletion, reused b5c611c6/b5c614d2/6209b35f, and 13 precursor air-flow XMLs), RIVM 2016-0104 Chapter 6 (pp. 51–56, Tables 6.1, 6.2, 6.5, 6.6) & §17 Table S2.1 (pp. 125–126), and Huijbregts et al. 2017 (pp. 139, 141, 143–144).
assessment.comparison: Aligns single-VOC photochemical reactivity (CML 2002 POCP in kg C2H4 eq, omitting NOx and receptor exposure), EF 3.1 single human-health LOTOS-EUROS midpoint (kg NMVOC eq, 1:1 generic NMVOC and NOx parity), and ReCiPe 2016 split TM5-FASST human-health HOFP and terrestrial-ecosystem EOFP midpoints (kg NOx-eq; world average NMVOC = 0.18 and 0.29). assessment.values: Nine ev-ozone119-* records bind 43 structured numeric facts with exact primary literals and BigInt fixed-point verification of the 0.23435 quotient (0.234 at 3 sig figs vs published XML 0.235), cross-system and cross-receptor order reversals, regional titration sign flips, EF 3.1 location replication versus country-resolved Acidification/Terrestrial eutrophication rows, and five-pathway NOx / two-pathway CH4 / three-pathway chloromethane characterization.
